notes: Wrapped from existing Prismata repository artifact.
Preserves source metadata for future unwrap support.

content.text:
﻿menus:
  - id: menu.main
    key: menu.main
    udi: prismata.menu.main
    name: Main Menu
    title: Prismata Main Menu
    label: Prismata Main Menu
    position: Main
    order: 1
    type: main
    icon: "🏠"
    colourScheme: main-menu
    borderScheme: main-menu
    description: Primary entry point for Prismata.
    finalItemType: Quit
    visibilityMode: Static
    enableMode: Enabled
    registryKey: main.registry
    registryOverrides:
      menuTypes:
        main:
          defaultColourScheme: main-menu
          defaultBorderScheme: main-menu
    header:
      udi: prismata.menu.main.header
      text: Prismata Main Menu
      style: header
      colourScheme: header
      borderScheme: main-menu
      visibilityMode: Static
    footer:
      udi: prismata.menu.main.footer
      text: F1: Help | Q: Quit
      style: footer
      colourScheme: footer
      borderScheme: main-menu
      visibilityMode: Static
    items:
      - udi: prismata.menu.main.start
        key: main.start
        name: Start Prismata
        label: Start Prismata
        type: action
        order: 1
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: menu
        capability: prismata.app.start
        executeTarget: start_prismata
        icon: "▶"
        description: Launch the primary experience.

      - udi: prismata.menu.main.settings
        key: main.settings
        name: Settings
        label: Settings
        type: navigate
        order: 2
        selectionMethod: number
        action: navigate
        ui_framework: menu
        capability: prismata.menu.settings
        navigateTarget: menu.settings
        submenu_ref: menu.settings
        icon: "⚙️"
        description: Open settings and preferences.

  - id: menu.settings
    key: menu.settings
    udi: prismata.menu.settings
    name: Settings
    title: Settings
    label: Settings
    position: Sub
    parent: menu.main
    order: 2
    type: settings
    icon: "⚙️"
    colourScheme: settings-menu
    borderScheme: settings-menu
    description: Complete settings menu exemplar.
    finalItemType: Back
    visibilityMode: Conditional
    visibilityCondition: project_selected == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - project_selected
    enableMode: Conditional
    enableCondition: config_exists('config/project-menus/settings.yaml') == true
    enableDependencies:
      - config_exists
    header:
      udi: prismata.menu.settings.header
      text: Settings
      style: header
      colourScheme: header
      borderScheme: settings-menu
      visibilityMode: Conditional
      visibilityCondition: project_selected == true
      visibilityDependencies:
        - project_selected
    footer:
      udi: prismata.menu.settings.footer
      text: Use arrows to adjust and Enter to confirm.
      style: footer
      colourScheme: footer
      borderScheme: settings-menu
      visibilityMode: Static
    items:
      - udi: prismata.menu.settings.darkmode
        key: settings.darkmode
        name: Dark Mode
        label: Dark Mode
        type: toggle
        order: 1
        selectionMethod: toggle
        action: execute
        ui_framework: toggle_table
        capability: prismata.settings.toggle_dark_mode
        executeTarget: toggle_darkmode
        icon: "☾"
        description: Toggle dark mode styling.

      - udi: prismata.menu.settings.theme
        key: settings.theme
        name: Theme
        label: Theme
        type: carousel
        order: 2
        selectionMethod: carousel
        action: execute
        ui_framework: custom
        capability: prismata.settings.cycle_theme
        executeTarget: cycle_theme
        icon: "🎨"
        description: Cycle available themes.

  - id: menu.admin
    key: menu.admin
    udi: prismata.menu.admin
    name: Admin Tools
    title: Admin Tools
    label: Admin Tools
    position: Sub
    parent: menu.main
    order: 3
    type: admin
    icon: "🧰"
    colourScheme: admin-menu
    borderScheme: default
    description: Conditional admin tools menu.
    finalItemType: Back
    visibilityMode: Conditional
    visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - user_is_admin
    enableMode: Conditional
    enableCondition: feature_flag('admin_tools') == true
    enableDependencies:
      - admin_tools
    header:
      udi: prismata.menu.admin.header
      text: Admin Tools
      style: header
      colourScheme: header
      borderScheme: default
      visibilityMode: Conditional
      visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
      visibilityDependencies:
        - user_is_admin
    footer:
      udi: prismata.menu.admin.footer
      text: Admin mode.
      style: footer
      colourScheme: footer
      borderScheme: default
      visibilityMode: Conditional
      visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
      visibilityDependencies:
        - user_is_admin
